_comment: Single source of truth for BMS-EV controller facts. Update here; the documentation pages read this file at load time.

changes: Generator (genset) control via SoC hysteresis relay output
Battery heating and cooling control with per-cell thresholds and hysteresis

generator_control.note: Relay output only. The generator's starter circuit needs its own relay or contactor rated for the load.

interlocks: Both circuits switch off if battery communication is lost
Heating blocked above 50 C regardless of user setting
Heating and cooling never run simultaneously
Cooling takes priority when the pack is both too hot and too cold
Both circuits held off for the first seconds after power-up
thermal_control.note: Relay outputs only. Heater and cooling hardware need their own relays or contactors rated for the load.
